category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
prompt: Your wedding was scheduled the same day as the Georgia-Florida game. Explain to your fiancée why the venue has TVs now.
response:
My Love,

I know we dreamed of a wedding that was purely about us, and I promise you that this day still is. But I also know that asking our guests to ignore one of the most intense rivalries in college football on the same day as our wedding was always going to be a tall order.

I didn’t add the TVs to distract from our vows or our first dance. I added them so that when those moments aren't happening, our guests aren't secretly checking their phones under the tables, sneaking out to their cars, or mentally drifting away wondering about the score. I want everyone fully present and joyful with us, not anxiously waiting for the next commercial break so they can check an app.

Think of it this way: the TVs are there to *protect* our celebration, not compete with it. They’ll be off during the ceremony, the speeches, and our special moments. But during cocktail hour and the later part of reception, they’ll be on so our friends and family can enjoy the game guilt-free while still being right here celebrating our marriage.

I want our guests to give us their undivided attention when it matters most, and I want them to feel relaxed and happy the rest of the time. This way, we get the best of both worlds: a beautiful, focused wedding and a reception where nobody feels like they’re missing out.

I love you more than any rivalry, and I just want our day to be perfect for everyone.
